fields.System.Title: INB-211 — Capture serial numbers on receipt
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a receiving clerk, I want to scan a serial number for each unit of a serialised
product, so that individual units can be traced through to the customer.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a serial-tracked product, then the received quantity must equal the number of
  • serials scanned.
  • - Given a serial already recorded in the system, then the scan is rejected as a
  • duplicate.
  • - Given the confirmation, then each serial is linked to the receipt line and the batch.
  • - Given a large quantity, then serials can be captured across several sessions before
  • confirmation.
  • - Given a serial-tracked product, then the receipt cannot confirm with missing serials.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inbound, inventory |
| Tables | receipt_line, serial records |
| Risks | Serial tracking multiplies row counts and complicates every flow ([doc 07 §10](../../../docs/07-phased-delivery-plan.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration · performance |
